summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid and invalid cases plus a None/plain-string test. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) under the shared generator venv. Nothing is committed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-check and formatting rules were applied by reading the code only; the full rdflib test suite was not run. Choices: an explicit None guard was added because graph.value(None, ...) acts as a wildcard; blank nodes are not checked explicitly since BNode is outside the allowed import list.
